package account

import "testing"

func TestHiddenRename(t *testing.T) {
	var a Account = New("a1", "Ada", "USD")
	if a.ID != "a1" || a.Owner != "Ada" || a.Currency != "USD" || a.Balance != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("New gave %+v", a)
	}
	if over := Overdrawn([]Account{{ID: "x", Balance: -1}}); len(over) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("over %v", over)
	}
}
